description:
**Phase D follow-on. Deps: D3 (.19), E1 (.20), E3 (.22), E4 (.23), E5b (.25), A4 (.4).**

Port `tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/test/compaction-thinking-model.test.ts` —
the live Anthropic-API compaction-with-thinking test.

Surface: build an `Agent` + `Session` (or whatever the AgentSession analogue is)
with a reasoning-capable Claude model and `thinking_level: :high`, send a prompt,
wait for idle, call `Session.compact/0`, assert:
- non-empty `result.summary`
- `tokens_before > 0`
- after compaction, the first message in built context is a `CompactionSummaryMessage`

Auth: route through the existing Anthropic OAuth path (Claude Code Max detection
+ stored OAuth tokens) so the test runs locally for developers with an active
Claude subscription. Skip when no auth is resolvable.

Mirror upstream's two `describe.skipIf(!HAS_..._AUTH)` blocks: one for Antigravity-routed
Claude (if/when that provider lands) and one direct Anthropic. For the initial port
just do the Anthropic block — Antigravity is out-of-scope until that provider ships.
title: D3b. Live thinking-model compaction end-to-end test
